title: lead.routed_to_human
description: Lead Qualification's R2 inbound bypass: a lead sourced from webform, inbound_reply, or referral is always routed to a human regardless of its band (entity-model.md §5 R2). Emitted alongside the normal lead.qualified.{band} event, never instead of it — the lead is still scored so Learning can compare inbound vs. outbound score quality. Emitted by Lead Qualification. Consumed by the Slack notifier (M1.3, not built).

source.description: Always one of webform/inbound_reply/referral in practice — this event is only ever emitted for those three (R2).
